g.text: 03 / One Story and Its Evidence
Inspect the same run without inference; start another condition for a named comparison
1. Freeze Inputs
Resolve the source profile and UserSim preamble once. Save model identities and catalogue hash.
Select one source or Designer-derived input. Keep original rows, overlays and generated identities separate.
2. Start A Fresh Condition
Create a Deep Agents or Fabric-selected harness runtime with isolated target memory and read-only MCP.
Record effective configuration and runtime identity; enable native Relay exactly once.
3a. User / Judge / Summary Activation
Forward exact UserSim role messages to the gateway.
Admit each provider call against the shared budget.
Record the response and measured token usage.
3b. Advisor Activation
Send only the latest public learner message to target.
Target performs real MCP lookups and bounded inference.
Return the final public reply to UserSim.
4. Finalize And Inspect
Continue up to three conversation turns; preserve partial outputs, failures and native warnings.
Inspect native traces, artifacts and source code. Read per-turn Helix reasons before totals; missing evidence stays missing.
Repeat activations within one bounded conversation. Reuse saved evidence; add a condition only to test an explicit change.
